webhook_enabled.title: Wake webhook enabled
webhook_enabled.description: Optional incoming HTTP endpoint that a Gen1 Shelly device can call through its action or report URL when it wakes up, so a sleepy device is recognised as online at once instead of at the next poll that happens to reach it. Off by default.

webhook_port.title: Wake webhook port
webhook_port.description: Port of the wake webhook listener, only relevant when webhook_enabled is true.
